remarks.name: Swyx
remarks.role: achieve ambition with intentionality, intensity, integrity & insanity.
remarks.text: one thing i think people dont appreciate enough about @poolsideai is their unusual degree of openness — not only have they shipped an excellent Small model that somehow beat @thinkymachines at coding, but most people (like @eliebakouch) have been shouting out their excellent papers, but also they're among a rare few to actually expose their full eval dataset as well - beautifully published, with across 6 public benchmarks  with 4 runs each and hundreds of turns per run. you can satisfy for yourself if they rewardhack. brilliant.
remarks.translation: 有一件事我觉得大家还不够了解 @poolsideai，那就是他们非同寻常的开放程度——不仅发布了一款优秀的小型模型，在编程方面竟然击败了 @thinkymachines，而且大多数人（比如 @eliebakouch）都在称赞他们出色的论文。此外，他们是少数真正公开完整评估数据集的公司之一——数据发布得十分漂亮，涵盖6个公开基准测试，每个测试进行4轮，每轮包含数百次交互。你可以亲自验证他们是否存在奖励作弊行为。太棒了。
remarks.observation: 这条言论适合观察 AI 编程工具、设计到代码流程和软件生产方式的变化；需要结合产品发布或文档再做事实判断。

remarks.name: Amjad Masad
remarks.role: ceo replit. civilizationist
remarks.text:
Viktor was able to disrupt the agency model and make a lot of money by using Replit.

Then he figured: Why not automate the entire thing, not just the coding part?

The Agency: It's merely an agent loop...

So he asked our team for an MCP, and we built one and he's now built his autonomous agency.
remarks.translation: 维克托利用Replit打破了代理模式，赚了不少钱。然后他琢磨：既然编码部分能自动化，为什么不能把整个流程都自动化呢？所谓代理，不过是一个代理循环……于是他向我们团队要了一个MCP，我们开发了一个，现在他已经建起了自己的自主代理机构。

Chatted with a friend who leads security at a public company following the GPT Sol incident. some interesting takeaways.. 

How do you manage security for effectively infinite agents when identity and access management was designed for a finite number of employees?

One employee can now spin up hundreds of agents. Those agents can spawn more agents.

Traditionally, each employee has an identity, a role, permissions, and a lifecycle.

Do agents inherit the spawning employee’s permissions? What’s their lifecycle - a task, a ticket, a week? Do child agents inherit the same permissions? How do you audit all of this?
remarks.translation: 与一位在上市公司负责安全的朋友聊了聊，就在GPT Sol事件之后。有些挺有意思的见解…… 当身份与访问管理原本是为有限数量的员工设计时，你如何管理实际上无限多的代理的安全？现在一个员工就能启动数百个代理。这些代理还能衍生出更多代理。传统上，每个员工都有一个身份、一个角色、权限和一个生命周期。代理会继承启动它们的员工的权限吗？它们的生命周期是怎样的——一个任务、一个工单、一周？子代理会继承相同的权限吗？这一切又该如何审计？
